description: Free. Every pump.fun buy and sell of $2,500 or more (min_usd from $1,000) in the last hour, oldest first, read from the chain as trades land: each with the wallet, the coin (name, symbol, mint), side, SOL, USD and the market cap at the trade. Give a wallet for that wallet's large trades only. For: what are whales buying on pump.fun, big buys right now, did this wallet buy or sell. A record of what wallets did, not a signal; then check_coin on a mint, wallet_records on a wallet.

since.description: unix seconds in the last hour; trades from it on. Left out: the whole hour
